fusions.name: Spore Canister
fusions.desc: Lobs a sealed canister of spores that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and leaves them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Inoculating Needle
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. A weapon strike through a culture needle that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Diseased] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Humidor Vent
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to set down a humming spore vent for 15 seconds. It mists an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Timer
fusions.desc: Every hit you land sets a spore timer on that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the spores fruit at once and strike it for 24% of your weapon damage per timer (143% at full). Unfed, a timer fades every 4 seconds.
